resources.string: Power the phone directly from the charger
Charges the battery normally, at the usual rate.
Phone runs off the charger only, 0 mA to the battery. Ideal for gaming.
No charger connected — the setting takes effect when you plug in.
Powers the phone directly from the charger without charging the battery. Reduces heat and battery wear during intensive tasks. Battery protection (temperature and voltage limits) stays fully active.
Tune display colours: hue, saturation, intensity, contrast
Apply the colour adjustments below to the display
Return all four sliders to the panel\'s normal values
Couldn\'t write to the display node

Hue rotates all colours around the colour wheel (\u2212180\u00b0 to +180\u00b0). Saturation controls colour vividness: negative mutes colours, positive makes them more vivid. Intensity and Contrast can only be reduced on this panel \u2014 their hardware fields are 8-bit, so the neutral value is already the maximum. Every slider defaults to 0, which is the panel\'s normal output. Values are saved and re-applied after a reboot, and take effect on the next screen refresh (toggle the screen if a change does not appear immediately).
